'''Fujiin blooms''' were exotic [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] that would release a noxious [[Gas/Legends|gas]] if an [[Species/Legends|organism]] was nearby. The gas it released would prevent organisms from breathing, resulting in [[Death/Legends|death]]. After the flowers released the gas, they would curl up and die.<ref name="Dooku's Secret Army" />
